reglasEsUn10Pero4: The group interprets the card however they like. No more rules!
reglasImpostor1: Choose the number of players, impostors, and rounds.
reglasImpostor2: Pass the phone in order: each player sees their role (citizen or IMPOSTOR) and closes the app.
reglasImpostor3: Citizens see the secret word; impostors see «IMPOSTOR» (and a hint if enabled).
reglasImpostor4: There is a debate round: everyone gives clues without revealing the word.
reglasImpostor5: Each voting round, the group votes on who they think is the impostor.
reglasImpostor6: Citizens win if they eliminate all impostors; impostors win if they survive all rounds.
reglasTrivia1: Up to 6 players compete by answering questions in turns.
reglasTrivia2: Questions range from easy to very hard throughout the rounds.
reglasTrivia3: A player who answers incorrectly is eliminated from the game.
reglasTrivia4: Players who survive all rounds tie as winners.
reglasTrivia5: Wins are saved by name — build up your ranking!
reglasWavelength1: One player secretly sees a target marked on a spectrum between two opposite concepts.
reglasWavelength2: That player gives a single verbal clue that places the target on the spectrum.
reglasWavelength3: The rest of the group moves the dial to show where they think the target is.
reglasWavelength4: Points are scored based on closeness to the real target — the closer, the better!
reglasWavelength5: It's cooperative: the group wins or loses together by accumulating points over all rounds.
reglasTabu1: Form two teams. The active player sees a word and its forbidden words.
reglasTabu2: They must describe the word WITHOUT saying any of the forbidden words.
reglasTabu3: Their team must guess it before time runs out.
reglasTabu4: Each correct guess scores a point for the team; saying a forbidden word takes one away (never below zero). A turn with at least one correct guess wins the round.
reglasTabu5: The first team to reach 3 wins the game.
reglasYoNunca1: The phone shows a random «I have never…» statement.
reglasYoNunca2: Anyone who has done it must admit it (or drink — whatever the group prefers!).
reglasYoNunca3: Pass the phone to the next player for the next statement.
reglasYoNunca4: Choose the level (mild for everyone, spicy for over-18s only) and, if you like, add your own statements from the top bar.
reglasBomba1: A syllable or category is shown on screen.
reglasBomba2: The current player says a valid word (containing the syllable or belonging to the category) and passes the phone quickly.
reglasBomba3: A bomb with a hidden timer explodes at a random moment.
reglasBomba4: The player holding the phone when it explodes is eliminated.
reglasBomba5: The last player standing wins the game.

legalTerminosTexto: 1. What it is Sajitarios Gamespot is a free app of party games to play as a group on a single phone. It works offline, with no accounts and no ads. 2. Using the app You may use it for your own and your group's entertainment. By using it you accept these terms. Use it respectfully: do not use it to harass, humiliate or hurt anyone. 3. Adult content Some content is for adults over 18 only and is marked as such: the "Banter" category in The Impostor and Taboo and the spicy mode of Never Have I Ever. Only turn it on if everyone in the group is an adult and agrees. 4. Alcohol Some games, such as Never Have I Ever, can be played as drinking games. The app does not encourage drinking: if you drink, do so in moderation, never pressure anyone, do not drive afterwards and respect the legal drinking age in your country. You can play just as well without alcohol. 5. Your content The words, cards and categories you create, player names and history are stored only on your phone. You are responsible for what you write. 6. Intellectual property The app, its design and its texts belong to their authors. Trivia questions are based on Open Trivia DB (CC BY-SA 4.0) and the Roboto and Material Icons fonts are by Google (Apache 2.0). Names of people, brands, works and places in the word lists are used only as references for playing: they imply no relationship or sponsorship. Details are under "Licenses". 7. No warranty The app is provided as is. We do our best to make it work well, but it may contain errors, including in the questions and words. To the extent permitted by law, its authors are not liable for any damage caused by its use. 8. Changes These terms may change with new versions of the app. The current terms are always the ones shown here. Last updated: 25 October 2026.
legalPrivacidadTexto: Summary Sajitarios Gamespot does not collect, send or sell personal data. It has no accounts, no ads and no analytics, and it does not need an internet connection. What is stored on your phone To work, the app stores on the device itself: • The player names from the last game. • The words, cards and categories you create. • The Impostor game history and trivia wins. • Your preferences: language, sound, vibration and animations. None of this leaves your phone or reaches its authors. Permissions The app only uses vibration (when the bomb explodes). You can turn it off in Settings. Deleting your data History and your words can be deleted from within the app. To delete everything, clear the app's data in the system settings or uninstall it. Children The app collects no data from anyone, including children. Some content is for adults over 18 only and is marked as such. Changes If a future version changed how data is handled, this policy would be updated first. Last updated: 25 October 2026.
legalCookiesTexto: Does it use cookies? No. Sajitarios Gamespot is an app, not a website, and it uses no cookies or any similar technology to track you or show you ads. Storage on your phone The app stores your preferences (language, sound, vibration and animations) and your games on your phone so everything stays as you left it. This is technical storage needed for the app to work: it identifies no one, is shared with no one and never leaves the device. Third parties There are no third-party advertising, analytics or social media services. How to delete it Clear the app's data in the system settings or uninstall it. Last updated: 25 October 2026.
